title: 先完成再完美！

coverage.excluded_asr_tail: S00040-S00042 overrun the audited media endpoint and are excluded from claims.

timeline.summary: A viewer asks about career and execution; he answers by rejecting conflicting perfection demands.
He says people often fail to act because they overthink and want the first attempt to be excellent or perfect.
He recommends personally running the whole workflow once, then delegating technical problems to specialists while retaining decisions.
He suggests delegating routine work only after the process is understood and warns against hiring before understanding it.
He closes with start first and solve encountered problems; the repeated ASR continuation past the cut is excluded.
